title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression CI hook + quality gating and metrics integration
author: Olivia Zhang
description: Motivation: prevent regressions in production prompt-sets by adding a CI hook that runs the eval-harness prompt regression checks and fails the PR when key eval metrics drop beyond configured thresholds. This change wires a new GitHub Actions job (eval-harness-ci) that runs a lightweight eval subset on PRs touching model-serving, prompts, or eval fixtures, publishes artifacts and a metrics summary, and integrates with the existing quality gating logic so repository maintainers can set strict/lenient thresholds per route. What I changed: added a new CI hook implementation (eval-harness/ci/hooks/prompt_regression_hook.py), a gating helper to compute delta thresholds (eval-harness/evals/metrics/gating.py), a small metrics exporter used by CI to upload JSON/CSV artifacts (eval-harness/tools/ci_metrics_exporter.py), updated the GH Actions workflow (.github/workflows/eval-harness-ci.yml), added unit and integration tests (tests/eval_harness/test_regression_gate.py, tests/fixtures/prompt_sets/minimal.json), and documented the behavior and configuration in docs/dev/eval-harness/ci.md. Checklist: - [x] CI job added and opt-in pattern implemented for large repos - [x] Threshold configuration (per-eval-set) and default safe values - [x] Tests for gating logic and end-to-end CI run (mocked runner) - [x] Docs + example config snippet - [x] Rollout plan (opt-in via labels for first 2 weeks) Backwards compatibility: defaults are non-blocking (warn-only) unless repo sets labels or config to gate on metrics. Breaking change: none by default. Rollout: enabled for eval-harness-owned PRs immediately, opt-in for other repos via label `eval-gate/enable`. See release_notes for details.

release_notes: Add CI-level prompt-set regression checks and quality gating for eval-harness. New GH Actions job publishes eval metrics artifacts and can be configured to fail PRs when eval metrics regress beyond repo-configured thresholds. Defaults are conservative/warn-only. Opt-in via label `eval-gate/enable` to enable blocking behavior.
